# ======================
# Import Libraries
# ======================
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.inspection import permutation_importance
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler

# ======================
# Load Data
# ======================
df = pd.read_csv("solardata.csv")

# Define features and target
features = ['PVOUT', 'DNI', 'GHI', 'DIF', 'OPTA', 'ELE', 'Temperature', 
            'Air Quality', 'Rainfall(mm)', 'UV index', 'Distance to Grid (Km)']
target = 'PVOUT'

X = df[features]
y = df[target]

# ======================
# Random Forest Feature Importance
# ======================
rf = RandomForestRegressor(random_state=42)
rf.fit(X, y)

rf_importance = pd.Series(rf.feature_importances_, index=features)
rf_importance = rf_importance / rf_importance.sum()
print("\nRandom Forest Feature Importance:\n", rf_importance.sort_values(ascending=False))

# ======================
# Permutation Feature Importance (Optional Insight)
# ======================
perm = permutation_importance(rf, X, y, n_repeats=10, random_state=42)
perm_importance = pd.Series(perm.importances_mean, index=features)
perm_importance = perm_importance / perm_importance.sum()
print("\nPermutation Feature Importance:\n", perm_importance.sort_values(ascending=False))

# ======================
# Smart AHP Calculation
# ======================
pairwise_matrix = np.array([
    [1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 7, 7, 9, 9, 9, 7],
    [1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 7, 7, 7, 5],
    [1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 7, 7, 7, 5],
    [1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 5, 3],
    [1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 5, 5, 5, 3],
    [1/7, 1/5, 1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3, 1],
    [1/7, 1/5, 1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3, 1],
    [1/9, 1/7, 1/7, 1/5, 1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 1, 1/3],
    [1/9, 1/7, 1/7, 1/5, 1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 1, 1/3],
    [1/9, 1/7, 1/7, 1/5, 1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 1, 1/3],
    [1/7, 1/5, 1/5, 1/3, 1/3, 1, 1, 3, 3, 3, 1]
])

col_sum = pairwise_matrix.sum(axis=0)
normalized_matrix = pairwise_matrix / col_sum

ahp_weights = normalized_matrix.mean(axis=1)
ahp_weights = pd.Series(ahp_weights, index=features)
ahp_weights = ahp_weights / ahp_weights.sum()

print("\nAHP Weights (smart matrix):\n", ahp_weights.sort_values(ascending=False))

# ======================
# Hybrid Weight Optimization
# ======================
optimal_alpha = 0.29

hybrid_weights = optimal_alpha * ahp_weights + (1 - optimal_alpha) * rf_importance
hybrid_weights = hybrid_weights / hybrid_weights.sum()

print("\nOptimized Weights (RF only):\n", rf_importance.sort_values(ascending=False))
print("\nHybrid Weights:\n", hybrid_weights.sort_values(ascending=False))
print(f"\nOptimal Alpha for Hybrid Score: {optimal_alpha:.3f}")

# ======================
# Normalize and Invert Features as Needed
# ======================
# Features where LOWER values are better
invert_features = ['Temperature', 'Rainfall(mm)', 'UV index', 'Distance to Grid (Km)']

scaler = MinMaxScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
X_scaled_df = pd.DataFrame(X_scaled, columns=features)

# Invert selected features
for col in invert_features:
    X_scaled_df[col] = 1 - X_scaled_df[col]

# ======================
# Score Calculation
# ======================
ahp_scores = np.dot(X_scaled_df, ahp_weights.values)
opt_scores = np.dot(X_scaled_df, rf_importance.values)
hybrid_scores = np.dot(X_scaled_df, hybrid_weights.values)

df['AHP_Score'] = ahp_scores
df['Optimized_Score'] = opt_scores
df['Hybrid_Score'] = hybrid_scores

top_ahp = df[['Location', 'AHP_Score']].sort_values('AHP_Score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
top_opt = df[['Location', 'Optimized_Score']].sort_values('Optimized_Score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
top_hybrid = df[['Location', 'Hybrid_Score']].sort_values('Hybrid_Score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

print("\nTop Locations based on AHP Score:\n", top_ahp.head(10))
print("\nTop Locations based on Optimized Score:\n", top_opt.head(10))
print("\nTop Locations based on Hybrid Score:\n", top_hybrid.head(10))

# ======================
# Visualization
# ======================

# Feature Weights Comparison
weight_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'AHP': ahp_weights,
    'Optimized (RF)': rf_importance,
    'Hybrid': hybrid_weights
})

weight_df.plot(kind='bar', figsize=(14,6))
sns.set_context("notebook", font_scale=1.5) 
plt.title('Comparison of Feature Weights (AHP vs Optimized vs Hybrid)')
plt.ylabel('Weight')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Top 10 Location Scores Plot
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(18,5))

axs[0].barh(top_ahp['Location'].head(10), top_ahp['AHP_Score'].head(10))
axs[0].set_title('Top 10 by AHP Score')
axs[0].invert_yaxis()

axs[1].barh(top_opt['Location'].head(10), top_opt['Optimized_Score'].head(10), color='orange')
axs[1].set_title('Top 10 by Optimized Score')
axs[1].invert_yaxis()

axs[2].barh(top_hybrid['Location'].head(10), top_hybrid['Hybrid_Score'].head(10), color='green')
axs[2].set_title('Top 10 by Hybrid Score')
axs[2].invert_yaxis()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

                 'Ramgati', 'Char Amanulla', 'Patharghata', 'Tazumoddin', 'Nangalkot Upazila',
                 'Zakiganj', 'Islampur'],
    'AHP Score': [0.768, 0.747, 0.685, 0.664, 0.597, 0.503, 0.502, np.nan, np.nan, 0.490, 0.489, 0.510],
    'Optimized Score': [0.964, 0.925, 0.792, 0.785, 0.763, 0.600, 0.582, 0.558, 0.551, 0.521, np.nan, np.nan],
    'Hybrid Score': [0.907, 0.873, 0.761, 0.750, 0.715, 0.572, 0.559, 0.529, 0.531, 0.512, np.nan, np.nan]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style

# Create melted dataframe for seaborn

# ===============================
# 1. Import Libraries
# ===============================
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

# ===============================
# 2. Load Your Solar Data
# ===============================
data = pd.read_csv('solardata.csv')

print("✅ Columns:", data.columns.tolist())
print(data.dtypes)  # See datatypes

# ===============================
# 3. Prepare Data
# ===============================

# Save location names
locations = data['Location']
pvout_series = data['PVOUT']

# Only select numeric columns
numeric_columns = data.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()

# Remove 'PVOUT' from features
feature_columns = [col for col in numeric_columns if col != 'PVOUT']
feature_data = data[feature_columns]

# Normalize Features
normalized_features = (feature_data - feature_data.min()) / (feature_data.max() - feature_data.min())

# ===============================
# 4. Define Weights
# ===============================

# AHP Weights
ahp_weights = pd.Series({
    'PVOUT': 0.301128,
    'DNI': 0.168159,
    'GHI': 0.168159,
    'DIF': 0.088539,
    'OPTA': 0.088539,
    'ELE': 0.042457,
    'Temperature': 0.042457,
    'Distance to Grid (Km)': 0.042457,
    'Air Quality': 0.019369,
    'Rainfall(mm)': 0.019369,
    'UV index': 0.019369
})

# Optimized Weights
optimized_weights = pd.Series({
    'PVOUT': 0.628941,
    'GHI': 0.193151,
    'DNI': 0.116196,
    'DIF': 0.022995,
    'UV index': 0.017312,
    'Temperature': 0.007199,
    'Rainfall(mm)': 0.005484,
    'Air Quality': 0.004752,
    'Distance to Grid (Km)': 0.001772,
    'ELE': 0.001273,
    'OPTA': 0.000926
})

# Match feature orders
ahp_weights = ahp_weights[feature_columns]
optimized_weights = optimized_weights[feature_columns]

# ===============================
# 5. Function to Compute Hybrid Weights
# ===============================

def compute_hybrid_weights(alpha, ahp_w, opt_w):
    return alpha * ahp_w + (1 - alpha) * opt_w

# ===============================
# 6. Find Best Alpha using Spearman
# ===============================

alphas = np.linspace(0, 1, 101)  # from 0 to 1
spearman_scores = []

for alpha in alphas:
    hybrid_weights = compute_hybrid_weights(alpha, ahp_weights, optimized_weights)
    hybrid_scores = normalized_features.dot(hybrid_weights)
    corr, _ = spearmanr(hybrid_scores, pvout_series)
    spearman_scores.append(corr)

# Find best alpha
best_alpha_index = np.argmax(spearman_scores)
best_alpha = alphas[best_alpha_index]
best_corr = spearman_scores[best_alpha_index]

print(f"\n✅ Best Alpha (α): {best_alpha:.3f}")
print(f"✅ Spearman Correlation at Best Alpha: {best_corr:.4f}")

# ===============================
# 7. Plot Spearman Correlation vs Alpha
# ===============================

plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.set_context("notebook", font_scale=1) 
plt.plot(alphas, spearman_scores, marker='o')
plt.axvline(x=best_alpha, color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Best α = {best_alpha:.2f}')
plt.title('Spearman Correlation vs Alpha (α)')
plt.xlabel('Alpha (α)')
plt.ylabel('Spearman Correlation with PVOUT')
plt.grid(True)
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# ===============================
# 8. Calculate Final Hybrid Score for Best Alpha
# ===============================

final_hybrid_weights = compute_hybrid_weights(best_alpha, ahp_weights, optimized_weights)
final_scores = normalized_features.dot(final_hybrid_weights)

# Create Ranking Table
ranking_table = pd.DataFrame({
    'Location': locations,
    'Hybrid Score': final_scores
}).sort_values(by='Hybrid Score', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

# ===============================
# 9. Show Top 10 Locations
# ===============================

print("\n🏆 Top 10 Best Locations Based on Final Hybrid Score:")
print(ranking_table.head(10))

# Import Libraries
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score, mean_squared_error

# Load and preprocess dataset
data = df.copy()
features = [
    "PVOUT", "DNI", "GHI", "DIF", "OPTA", "ELE", 
    "Temperature", "Air Quality", "Rainfall(mm)"
]
target = "Distance to Grid (Km)"

X = data[features]
y = data[target]

# Step 1: AHP Weights (normalized to sum to 1)
ahp_weights = pd.Series({
    'PVOUT': 0.301128,
    'DNI': 0.168159,
    'GHI': 0.168159,
    'DIF': 0.088539,
    'OPTA': 0.088539,
    'ELE': 0.042457,
    'Temperature': 0.042457,
    'Distance to Grid (Km)': 0.042457,
    'Air Quality': 0.019369,
    'Rainfall(mm)': 0.019369,
    'UV index': 0.019369
})

# Step 2: ML-based Feature Importance using Gradient Boosting
gbr_model = GradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42)
gbr_model.fit(X, y)
train_predictions = gbr_model.predict(X)

print("R2 Score:", r2_score(y, train_predictions))
print("RMSE:", mean_squared_error(y, train_predictions, squared=False))

# Step 3: Extract Feature Importances and Normalize
ml_importance = dict(zip(X.columns, gbr_model.feature_importances_))
ml_importance_normalized = {k: v / sum(ml_importance.values()) for k, v in ml_importance.items()}

# Combine AHP and ML Weights
alpha = 0.29  # Weight for AHP
hybrid_weights = {
    feature: alpha * ahp_weights[feature] + (1 - alpha) * ml_importance_normalized[feature]
    for feature in features
}
hybrid_weights_normalized = {k: v / sum(hybrid_weights.values()) for k, v in hybrid_weights.items()}

# Create a comparison DataFrame
weights_comparison = pd.DataFrame({
    "Feature": features,
    "AHP Weight": [ahp_weights[feat] for feat in features],
    "ML Weight": [ml_importance_normalized[feat] for feat in features],
    "Hybrid Weight": [hybrid_weights_normalized[feat] for feat in features]
})

# Step 4: Compute Scores per Location
def compute_score(row, weights):
    return sum(row[feature] * weights[feature] for feature in features)

data["AHP_Score"] = data.apply(lambda row: compute_score(row, ahp_weights), axis=1)
data["ML_Score"] = data.apply(lambda row: compute_score(row, ml_importance_normalized), axis=1)
data["Hybrid_Score"] = data.apply(lambda row: compute_score(row, hybrid_weights_normalized), axis=1)

# Step 5: Ranking
data["Rank_AHP"] = data["AHP_Score"].rank(ascending=False)
data["Rank_ML"] = data["ML_Score"].rank(ascending=False)
data["Rank_Hybrid"] = data["Hybrid_Score"].rank(ascending=False)

# Step 6: Visualizations
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x="AHP_Score", y="ML_Score", data=data, hue="Division", s=80)
plt.title("AHP vs ML Scores")
plt.xlabel("AHP Score")
plt.ylabel("ML Score")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x="Hybrid_Score", y="Distance to Grid (Km)", data=data, hue="Division", s=80)
plt.title("Hybrid Score vs Distance to Grid")
plt.xlabel("Hybrid Score")
plt.ylabel("Distance to Grid (Km)")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Step 7: Top Locations by Hybrid Score
top_locations = data.sort_values("Hybrid_Score", ascending=False).head(10)
print("Top 10 Recommended Locations by Hybrid Score:")
print(top_locations[["Division", "Location", "Hybrid_Score", "Distance to Grid (Km)"]])

# Display final weights table
print("\nWeight Comparison Table:")
print(weights_comparison)
